# documents v1

Who archives a document and who deletes one: what can be archived is archived, not deleted. A sketch of an office's own terms, written as sekisho's example of having the weaker of two operations used first

## Who may do what

For each action, the combinations `sekisho check` walked, put together where Cedar answers them alike and the same policies decide. Rows that differ in one column only are one row, the column holding their values: `any` is every value the column takes, `not …` every value but one. `-` is a column that does not apply to the row (the roles of a workflow, say).

### action `view_document`

Look at a document

- It guards no operation.
- Principals: `User`. Resources: `Document`, the id read from the operation's argument `documentId`.
- 2 combinations, 1 of them allowed.

#### Allowed

| principal | staff | Deciding policies |
|---|---|---|
| User | yes | staff_view_documents |

- No permit applies to the 1 combination that is denied.

### action `delete_document`

Delete a document for good

- It guards no operation.
- Principals: `User`. Resources: `Document`, the id read from the operation's argument `documentId`.
- Reads `allowed archive_document`: whether `archive_document` is allowed for the same principal and resource, as the table of `archive_document` on this page says (under Computed values below).
- 16 combinations, 1 of them allowed.

#### Allowed

| principal | staff | status | held | resource.owner is principal | allowed archive_document | Deciding policies |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| User | yes | draft | no | yes | no | owners_delete_their_documents |

#### Denied

- `what_can_be_archived_is_not_deleted` (`when allowed archive_document`) applies to 1 combination, and denies each; a permit applies to 1 of them too, and the forbid wins.
- No permit applies to the 14 other combinations that are denied.

## Policies

Each policy as the `.gate` writes it, beside the Cedar `sekisho gen --target cedar` generates for it. A permit allows the combinations it applies to; a forbid denies those it applies to, and wins where a permit applies too. Cedar denies a combination no policy applies to.

### permit `staff_view_documents`

The staff look at any document

- On `view_document`, it allows 1 combination, which no other permit allows.

`documents.gate`

```gate
permit staff_view_documents
  description "The staff look at any document"
  principal in staff
  action view_document
```

`cedar/documents.cedar`

```cedar
@id("documents/staff_view_documents")
@doc("The staff look at any document")
permit (
  principal in Records::Role::"staff",
  action == Records::Action::"view_document",
  resource is Records::Document
);
```

### permit `owners_archive_final_documents`

The owner of a final document archives it, unless it is held

- On `archive_document`, it allows 1 combination, which no other permit allows.

`documents.gate`

```gate
permit owners_archive_final_documents
  description "The owner of a final document archives it, unless it is held"
  principal in staff
  action archive_document
  when resource.status is final
  when resource.owner is principal
  unless resource.held
```

`cedar/documents.cedar`

```cedar
@id("documents/owners_archive_final_documents")
@doc("The owner of a final document archives it, unless it is held")
permit (
  principal in Records::Role::"staff",
  action == Records::Action::"archive_document",
  resource is Records::Document
)
when { resource.status == "final" }
when { resource.owner == principal }
unless { resource.held };
```

### permit `owners_delete_their_documents`

The owner of a document deletes it, unless it is held

- On `delete_document`, it allows 1 combination, which no other permit allows.

`documents.gate`

```gate
permit owners_delete_their_documents
  description "The owner of a document deletes it, unless it is held"
  principal in staff
  action delete_document
  when resource.owner is principal
  unless resource.held
```

`cedar/documents.cedar`

```cedar
@id("documents/owners_delete_their_documents")
@doc("The owner of a document deletes it, unless it is held")
permit (
  principal in Records::Role::"staff",
  action == Records::Action::"delete_document",
  resource is Records::Document
)
when { resource.owner == principal }
unless { resource.held };
```

### forbid `what_can_be_archived_is_not_deleted`

A document the person could archive is archived, not deleted

- On `delete_document`, it applies to 1 combination and denies them; a permit applies to 1 of them too.

`documents.gate`

```gate
forbid what_can_be_archived_is_not_deleted
  description "A document the person could archive is archived, not deleted"
  action delete_document
  when allowed archive_document
```

`cedar/documents.cedar`

```cedar
@id("documents/what_can_be_archived_is_not_deleted")
@doc("A document the person could archive is archived, not deleted")
forbid (
  principal,
  action == Records::Action::"delete_document",
  resource is Records::Document
)
when { context.allowed_archive_document };
```

## Computed values

What an action computes and gives Cedar in its context. The generated code computes each one from the service's own data, the operation's arguments and the server's clock, and never takes it from the caller. The pages of the rules and the dates are the pages for people that rulec and koyomi draw, as they draw them.

### `allowed_archive_document` of `delete_document`

- Written: `allowed archive_document`
- Whether `archive_document` is allowed for the same principal and resource, on the same day. The generated code asks it first, through the function of `archive_document`, and puts the answer in the context before it asks this action; why `archive_document` was refused, when it was, is why this request is refused.
- Its values: yes and no (true and false in Cedar).
- Its values are as the table of `archive_document` on this page says.

## Expectations, separations and roles

### Expectations

- `final_documents_are_archived_not_deleted` (expects deny, on `delete_document`): The owner of a final document that is not held never deletes it: it is archived instead. It holds on all 2 combinations it picks.
- `owners_delete_their_drafts` (expects allow, on `delete_document`): The owner of a draft that is not held deletes it. It holds on all 1 combination it picks.

### Roles

- `staff`: Writes the office's documents, and keeps their own. Its `can` lists `view_document`, `archive_document` and `delete_document`.

Whether a principal holding one role alone (and the roles it includes) is allowed each action: always, in every combination of the rest; sometimes, allowed in some combinations and denied in others; never, denied in every one. `-` is an action that does not take the principal's type. Where a role writes `can`, `sekisho check` holds the actions it is always or sometimes allowed to it.

| principal | `view_document` | `archive_document` | `delete_document` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `User` holding `staff` | always | sometimes | sometimes |

## Operations guarded

No action guards an operation of a contract.
